title: Insurance claim photo assessment
summary: Motor claims with damage photos: AI damage assessment, decision-table triage and SLA, adjuster review, letters, and photos with faces and plates blurred for repairers.
description:
Insurance claim photo assessment starts from a claim form page where the claimant enters their policy, what happened and uploads photos of the damage (the camera opens on phones).

Analyze Image describes the damage and returns a structured assessment: severity, damaged parts, a rough cost range, whether the vehicle looks drivable and whether the photo matches the story. The Damage triage decision table turns that and the cover into a band (fast track, standard, specialist or coverage check), an estimate band, a decision SLA and whether an inspection is suggested. Every photo is also copied with faces and licence plates blurred, because repairers do not need them.

The adjuster reviews the claim with the AI assessment clearly marked as a hint, picks a repairer from the Approved repairers table and approves the repair, asks for an inspection or declines. Approval and decline letters are generated as PDFs and emailed, and the chosen repairer gets the job with the blurred photos only. The adjuster always decides.
start: Starts from a form page: share the Motor claim form (/f/<id>) in your app or website; each claim starts the workflow.
setup: Google Gemini (media AI): paste your Gemini API key. It analyses the damage and finds faces and plates to blur.
Assignees: pick the adjuster who reviews claims (escalates to their manager after 48 hours).
Tune the Damage triage bands and replace the sample Approved repairers.
Set EMAIL_PROVIDER so claimants and repairers receive their emails.
